topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I heard tell that our old building's to turn into condos. The landlord reckoned it was time for a change, but I can’t help but think what that means for all of us. We've lived here for years, the walls know our stories, and the garden's seen the hands of more than one generation. These walls, they've held us through the winters and seen us through the springs. I’m not sure how to plant my feet in this new soil. Folks are talking, saying we might have to find new homes, and the thought of it seems as daunting as a cloudy sky at harvest time. I reckon I’ll need to speak with the others, see if there’s a way to cling to our roots a little longer.
